item.title: Venus in Gemini: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Venus in Gemini means Venus was in Gemini when you were born. In astrology Venus stands for how you love and connect; Gemini is an air sign ruled by Mercury, curious and quick. Conversation is your love language, and you are fluent. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Mercury in Aries: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Mercury in Aries means Mercury was in Aries when you were born. In astrology Mercury stands for how you think and speak; Aries is a fire sign ruled by Mars, direct and brave. You think in headlines and speak before the ink dries. Read more at astralroots.app
